LanguageData.RatkinQL_ScoutTree_Report: A ratkin scout passed by and warned us about nearby danger.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Scout_Greeting: “Hey, {Interviewer_labelShort}.” The ratkin scout keeps his voice low. “Got here just in time. There’s trouble heading your way. Something you’ll want to know about.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Scout_OptReward: “Thanks, have some silver for the tip.” (15 silver)
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Scout_OptDetails: “Tell me more — what exactly is it?”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Scout_OptHeed: “I’ll keep an eye out. Appreciate the warning.”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Scout_Details1: “Bandit crew — maybe six or seven of them — were spotted two hills east. They’re driftin’ this direction fast.”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Scout_Details2: “A pack of mad boomalopes, foamin’ at the mouth. They tore through a farm north of here and they’re not stopping.”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Scout_Details3: “Big snow front coming down from the mountains. Could bury this place in a day if you’re not ready.”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Scout_Farewell: “Right. I got rounds to make. Stay sharp.” He gives a quick salute and pads away.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Scout_MsgReward: The scout pockets the silver and nods, a quick grin flickering on his face. “Obliged. That’ll buy my next meal.”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Scout_MsgHeed: “Good.” He nods once, then slips away into the underbrush.
